benefit.name: Local transit & recreation discounts
benefit.summary: Many cities and towns run their own low-income or disability discounts on transit passes and recreation. 2-1-1 can help you find yours.
benefit.note: Programs are named and run differently in every community. 2-1-1 is a free, confidential service that finds the ones near you.

detail.about: Beyond the biggest cities, many municipalities offer their own low-income or disability discounts on transit and recreation — but they're all named and delivered differently. 2-1-1 is a free, confidential service that connects you to the specific programs in your community. In most of Canada you can reach it 24 hours a day, in more than 150 languages. In BC, 211 navigators are available 9am to 9pm, Monday to Friday, excluding statutory holidays.
steps: Visit your provincial 2-1-1 site, or simply dial 2-1-1 from any phone.
Tell them your town and what you need (transit, recreation, financial help).
They can point you to local programs and how to apply.
documents: A rough idea of your household income
tips: Dialing 2-1-1 is free. In most of Canada it is open 24 hours a day, in many languages. In BC, navigators are available 9am to 9pm on weekdays, excluding holidays.
Also search your town's own website for 'recreation fee assistance' or 'low-income transit pass'.
